title: logreach per-host index: profile key host_index sends listed hosts to another index (VNW web hosts -> vnw_access-*)
requirement: A logreach profile can route listed hosts to another ES index, same URL/creds/fields; others use the default index. REQ-0076 (RAW-00621, RAW-00622, RAW-00623)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 listed hosts query the override index, others the default
AC3 query log and report show the routed index
AC4 cache re-queries when a host moves index
AC6 VNW g01 rebuild: vnw_access-* only for the 4 web hosts, coverage gaps=0, QA PASS
AC7 filter_value list -> terms query, masked everywhere; single value unchanged

design.summary: Optional profile key host_index=<index>:<host>,..[;..] routes listed hosts to another ES index; index_for() in search/log/cache; report shows per-query index
risks: stale cache across map change (handled: record index compared)

implementation.summary: host_index key parsed to {host:index}; index_for() used by EsSource.search, query log and cache-staleness check; doc.es.host_index; report query blocks use the record index; 111.5 filter_value comma list -> terms query, masked as [<FILTER_VALUE>]

unit_test.result: 4 suites passed: logreach_test 148/0, logreach_report 37/0, logreach_render 37/0, pipeline_logreach 13/0 (re-run by main after 111.5)

security.result: no credential or filter value in logreach.json, query log or reports (masked term/terms); TLS-off WARN kept; only the configured ES URL contacted; bad host_index/filter list -> profile_unreadable

verification.result: VNW: secure.* queries -> vnw_access-* (4), others -> vnw_api_access-* (101); filter terms masked in 105/105 lines, 0 real IPs in outputs; PT-002/PT-019 now seen; coverage gaps=0, QA PASS, crosscheck fail=0. Upzi verdicts identical. Verifier AC1-AC7 PASS (AC6: only secure.* of the 4 web hosts had findings).

tester.waiver: main re-ran tests/run_all.sh logreach itself (4 suites pass); small change
